title: cwht Stakeholder Expectations (L0)
description: Schema for docs/requirements/l0-stakeholder/expectations.json: the identified stakeholders (SE HB 4.1.1.2.1; NPR 7123.1D SE-35), Needs, Goals and Objectives (NGO-NNN), Measures of Effectiveness (MOE-NNN) and Constraints (CON-NNN) per SE HB 4.1.1.2.3, 4.1.1.2.6 and 4.2.1.2.1. Every entry traces to stakeholder inputs SI-NNN in stakeholder-inputs.md (SE HB 4.1.1.2.7). L0 entries are expectations, not requirements: statements never contain 'shall'. The stakeholders array is required once the file carries a baseline tag (baselined at SRR with the rest of the file). Process: docs/process/02-requirements-and-traceability.md section 3.

baseline.description: Git tag of the baseline under which this file was last approved (baseline/srr at the SRR flip of process section 11.2); null before SRR. When set, the stakeholders array is required.

stakeholders.description: Stakeholders identified per SE HB 4.1.1.2.1 (process section 3.0): who is affected by or has a stake in the radio, what they care about and who speaks for them in validation step V2. Required when baseline is set (SRR, SE-35). Entries are keyed by name (unique, checked by tool rule T-21); charter section 6 defines no stakeholder id scheme (process section 14, CI-10).

ngos.description: Needs, Goals and Objectives. One Need per file. Goals trace to the Need, Objectives to a Goal (SE HB 4.1.1.2.3). The schema checks id patterns only; the Need count, parent kinds and id resolution are tool rule T-21 (process section 8.2).

moes.description: Measures of Effectiveness: success criteria stated from the owner's point of view (SE HB 4.1.1.2.6). Quantified by MOP-NNN entries in docs/plan/tpm.json mops[] (added before SRR; process section 6.2), not here.

constraints.description: Conditions the design must meet that are not open to trade (SE HB 4.2.1.2.1): regulation, existing interfaces, mandated technology, resources.

name.description: Person, group or organization, e.g. 'Robin (owner)', 'Friends who receive and operate units', 'Federal Communications Commission'. Unique within the array.

role.description: customer: requests and accepts the product; user: operates it as their own station; guest operator: operates a unit loaned or handed over by the owner (SI-019); regulator: imposes rules the product must meet (47 CFR, SI-014); vendor: supplies fabrication, assembly or parts under catalog terms (PCBWay, DigiKey); supplier: produces the design and evidence (Claude, SI-011); public: anyone who reuses the open design (SI-025) or is near a transmitting unit

interests.description: What the stakeholder expects or is affected by, stated without 'shall' (SE HB 4.1.1.2.1)

represented_by.description: Who speaks for the stakeholder in validation step V2 (process sections 3.0 and 5) and the record that establishes it, e.g. 'Robin, per the SRR decision memo'

source_ids.description: Stakeholder inputs that identify this stakeholder or state their interests

note.description: Optional clarification, e.g. why the stakeholder has no separate voice in V2

regulation_clause.description: 47 CFR clause from Part 1, 2, 15 or 97 (charter section 1), e.g. 47CFR97.307(e) or 47CFR1.1310; the <part>.<section> resolves to a corpus file docs/references/md/regulatory/47cfr-<part>.<section>.md or an extract 47cfr-<part>.<section>-<slug>.md such as 47cfr-2.106-harmonic-bands.md (process section 3.4, tool rule T-07)

cr_id.description: Record that retired the entry: a Change Request CR-NNN after the SRR baseline; before it, a RID-<REVIEW>-NNN (review tokens of charter section 6) or the INSP-NNN peer-review record whose finding motivated the retirement (process sections 8.3 and 11.3)

status.description: Draft until the SRR decision memo baselines the file (process section 11.2 flips every Draft entry to Baselined and sets baseline to baseline/srr in one commit); Retired entries keep their ID and carry retired_by. Allowed transitions (process section 8.3, tool rule T-12): Draft to Baselined at the SRR flip; Draft to Retired before SRR (retired_by a RID or INSP id); Baselined to Retired only by an approved CR; Baselined text changes only by an approved CR. Forbidden: Baselined to Draft; Retired to anything. This schema already carries the Retired status that charter section 6 anticipates; the requirement and test-case schemas use the interim marker of process section 11.3.

expectation_statement.description: Plain-language expectation. Expectations are not requirements: 'shall' is forbidden here (SE HB 4.1.1.2.3: NGOs are not contractual requirements).

kind.description: Need: the single problem statement. Goal: elaboration of the Need. Objective: specific, measurable target level for a Goal (SE HB 4.1.1.2.3).

parent_id.description: null for the Need; the Need's id for a Goal; a Goal's id for an Objective

rationale.description: Why the expectation exists, assumptions made, and anything needed to manage it (SE HB 4.1.1.2.3)

source_ids.description: Stakeholder inputs this entry was distilled from

success_criterion.description: How the owner will judge the MOE met when using the delivered radio (validation, SE HB 5.4). May be qualitative; MOPs supply the numbers.

ngo_ids.description: Objectives or Goals whose accomplishment this MOE measures

ops_ids.description: ConOps scenarios in which the MOE is judged; empty only while docs/conops/conops.md does not exist, populated before SRR

rationale.description: Who imposes the constraint and what relief, if any, the owner can grant

source_ids.description: Stakeholder inputs or regulation clauses that impose the constraint
